CULT.title: Cultivators
CULT.division: Skilled Agricultural, Forestry and Fishery Workers
CULT.description: Cultivators are persons who cultivate land they own or hold tenancy/lease rights to, or hold from the Government, bearing the risk of cultivation themselves. This is one of the Indian Census's four basic worker categories (Census of India 2011 Primary Census Abstract), not a National Classification of Occupations code — the Census does not further break cultivators down by NCO occupation.

AGLAB.title: Agricultural Labourers
AGLAB.description: Agricultural labourers work on another person's land for wages in cash, kind, or a share of produce, without risk in cultivation and without owning/leasing the land they work. This is one of the Indian Census's four basic worker categories (Census of India 2011 Primary Census Abstract), not a National Classification of Occupations code — the Census does not further break agricultural labourers down by NCO occupation.

UNCL1.title: Other Managers (unclassified)
UNCL1.description: A residual bucket of workers whose Census 2011 occupation code (NCO-2004) could not be confidently matched to a specific NCO-2015 occupation for this visualization — either a renamed/discontinued code, or a gap in the PDF-derived NCO-2004→NCO-2015 crosswalk. Grouped here so total employment still reconciles to the real Census total, at the cost of occupation-level detail for this slice.
